mapper.sql: t.trip_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.scope, t.share_token, t.del_yn, t.created_at, p.end_date, p.day_count, (select u.nickname from trip_member m join users u on u.user_id = m.user_id where m.trip_id = t.trip_id and m.role = 'OWNER') as owner_nickname, (select count(*) from trip_member m where m.trip_id = t.trip_id and m.status = 'JOINED') as member_count
mapper.select: select t.trip_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.scope, t.created_at, p.end_date, p.day_count, m.role as my_role, (select listagg(r.region, ', ') within group (order by ) from trip_region r where r.trip_id = t.trip_id) as region_names from trip t join trip_member m on m.trip_id = t.trip_id join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'JOINED' and t.del_yn = 'N' order by t.created_at desc, t.trip_id desc
select from trip t join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id where t.trip_id = #{tripId} and t.del_yn = 'N'
select from trip t join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id where t.share_token = #{shareToken} and t.del_yn = 'N'
select r.region from trip_region r where r.trip_id = #{tripId} order by
mapper.insert:
select seq_trip.nextval from dual
insert into trip (trip_id, title, start_date, scope, share_token) values (#{tripId}, #{title}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'PRIVATE', #{shareToken})

insert all
into trip_region (trip_id, region) values (#{tripId}, #{region})
select * from dual
insert into trip_member (trip_id, user_id, role, status) values (#{tripId}, #{userId}, 'OWNER', 'JOINED')
mapper.update: update trip set del_yn = 'Y' where del_yn = 'N' and trip_id in (select m.trip_id from trip_member m where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.role = 'OWNER')
mapper.select: select count(*) from schedule s join trip_day d on d.day_id = s.day_id where d.trip_id = #{tripId}
select count(*) from schedule s join trip_day d on d.day_id = s.day_id where d.trip_id = #{tripId} and (s.time is null or s.place_name is null)
